mapper.select: select v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url, v.video_url, v.duration, v.user_id, v.category_id, v.status, v.view_count, v.like_count, v.comment_count, v.share_count, v.create_time, v.update_time, u.nickname, u.avatar from video v left join user u on v.user_id = u.id where v.status = 1 and (u.status is null or u.status = 1) and v.id not in ( select r.target_id from report r where r.target_type = 1 and r.status = 1 union select h.target_id from sensitive_hit_log h where h.target_type = 'video' and h.target_id is not null ) and (v.user_id not in ( select p.user_id from user_penalty p where p.status = 1 and p.action = 'ban' )) order by (v.view_count + v.like_count * 3 + v.comment_count * 4 + v.share_count * 2) * pow(0.5, timestampdiff(hour, v.create_time, now()) / 72.0) + (case when ifnull(v.is_original, 1) = 1 then 5 else 0 end) desc, v.create_time desc LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

select v.id, v.title, v.cover_url as coverUrl, v.duration, v.user_id as userId, v.category_id as categoryId, v.view_count as viewCount, v.like_count as likeCount, v.comment_count as commentCount, v.share_count as shareCount, v.create_time as createTime, u.nickname, u.avatar, ifnull(f.hot_score, (v.view_count + v.like_count * 3 + v.comment_count * 4 + v.share_count * 2) * pow(0.5, timestampdiff(hour, v.create_time, now()) / 72.0) + (case when ifnull(v.is_original, 1) = 1 then 5 else 0 end) ) as hotScore from video v left join user u on v.user_id = u.id left join video_feature f on f.video_id = v.id and f.pool_status = 1 where v.status = 1 and (u.status is null or u.status = 1) and v.id not in ( select r.target_id from report r where r.target_type = 1 and r.status = 1 union select h.target_id from sensitive_hit_log h where h.target_type = 'video' and h.target_id is not null ) and (v.user_id not in ( select p.user_id from user_penalty p where p.status = 1 and p.action = 'ban' )) order by hotScore desc, v.create_time desc limit #{size}
